examples.chinese: A：現在幾點？ B：現在十點二十五分。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? B: Xiànzài shí diǎn èrshíwǔ fēn.
examples.english: A: What time is it now? B: It’s 10:25.

examples.chinese: 現在幾點鐘？
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài jǐ diǎnzhōng?
examples.english: What time is it now?

examples.chinese: 你幾點去學校？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn qù xuéxiào?
examples.english: What time do you go to school?

examples.chinese: 你幾點去圖書館？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐdiǎn qù túshūguǎn?
examples.english: What time will you go to the library?

examples.chinese: 你幾點下課？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn xiàkè?
examples.english: What time do you get out of class?

examples.chinese: 你昨天幾點回家？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān jǐ diǎn huí jiā?
examples.english: What time did you go home yesterday?

examples.chinese: 宜文昨天幾點睡覺？
examples.pinyin: Yíwén zuótiān jǐ diǎn shuìjiào?
examples.english: What time did Yiwen go to sleep yesterday?

examples.chinese: 元真，我們明天幾點去找妳的韓國朋友？
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, wǒmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn qù zhǎo nǐ de Hánguó péngyǒu?
examples.english: Yuanzhen, what time are we going to meet up with your Korean friends tomorrow?

items.wordHook: 幾(how many) + 點(o'clock points) → 'how many points on the clock?' 幾點 asks the time.

examples.chinese: 我弟弟喜歡打棒球，我想送他一個棒球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi xǐhuān dǎ bàngqiú, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge bàngqiú.
examples.english: My younger brother likes playing baseball, I’d like to give him a baseball as a gift.

items.wordHook: 棒(stick) + 球(ball) → a stick hits the ball, that's baseball.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

items.wordHook: 緊(tight) + 張(stretched) → your body feels tight and stretched when nervous.

examples.chinese: 我討厭下雨，因為出去玩很不方便。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tǎoyàn xiàyǔ, yīnwèi chūqù wán hěn bù fāngbiàn.
examples.english: I dislike rainy days because going out to have fun is very inconvenient.

examples.chinese: 爸爸常教導我做人要謙虛，太驕傲的話，不僅讓人討厭，做事也可能不順利。
examples.pinyin: Bàba cháng jiàodǎo wǒ zuòrén yào qiānxū, tài jiāo'ào de huà, bùjǐn ràng rén tǎoyàn, zuòshì yě kěnéng bù shùnlì.
examples.english: Dad often teaches me to be modest. If you are too arrogant, not only will people dislike you, but things may not go smoothly either.

examples.chinese: 昨晚我接了好幾通沒有聲音的電話，真的很討厭。
有的小朋友很討厭打針，一看見護理師拿針筒(medical syringe)的樣子就哭了。
我討厭搬家，因為大型的家具不好搬運。
中秋節是華人團圓的日子，除了吃月餅、欣賞月亮，還會一起烤肉。小文從小在育幼院長大，到了二十歲才找到叔叔，跟家人團圓了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié shì Huárén tuányuán de rìzi, chúle chī yuèbǐng, xīnshǎng yuèliang, hái huì yìqǐ kǎoròu. Xiǎowén cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, dào le èrshí suì cái zhǎodào shūshu, gēn jiārén tuányuán le.
examples.english: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for Chinese people to have family reunion. Besides eating mooncakes and admiring the moon, they also have a barbecue together. Xiaowen grew up in an orphanage from a young age, and only at the age of twenty did he find his uncle and have a reunion with his family.

examples.chinese: 蛋黃月餅的營養豐富，可是不能多吃，不然很容易發胖。
如果你希望有豐富的知識，就應該用功讀書。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xīwàng yǒu fēngfù de zhīshì, jiù yīnggāi yònggōng dúshū.
examples.english: If you hope to have abundant knowledge, you should study hard.

examples.chinese: 多閱讀書報、雜誌，能讓我們的知識更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Duō yuèdú shūbào, zázhì, néng ràng wǒmen de zhīshì gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: Reading more books, newspapers, and magazines can make our knowledge richer.

examples.chinese: 黃教授不僅知識豐富、上課認真，還很關心學生，大家都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Huáng jiàoshòu bùjǐn zhīshì fēngfù, shàngkè rènzhēn, hái hěn guānxīn xuéshēng, dàjiā dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: Professor Huang not only has rich knowledge and teaches seriously, but also cares about students very much; everyone respects him greatly.

examples.chinese: 王教授不但知識很豐富，研究成果也受到大家的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu búdàn zhīshi hěn fēngfù, yánjiū chéngguǒ yě shòudào dàjiā de kěndìng.
examples.english: Professor Wang not only has abundant knowledge, but his research results are also recognized by everyone.

examples.chinese: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 在學習新知識的過程中，總是會有開心與煩惱的時候。
教授學生做人的道理與教授知識同樣重要。
說實話，文憑不是最重要的，重要的是個人的知識與才能。
吃太多餅乾、薯條，只有壞處沒有好處。
examples.pinyin: Chī tài duō bǐnggān, shǔtiáo, zhǐ yǒu huàichù méiyǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: Eating too many cookies and French fries has only disadvantages and no benefits.

examples.chinese: 吃太多餅乾、薯條，只有壞處沒有好處。
examples.pinyin: Chī tài duō bǐnggān, shǔtiáo, zhǐ yǒu huàichù méiyǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: Eating too many cookies and French fries has only disadvantages and no benefits.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的性格開朗、樂觀，遇到麻煩也不會往壞處想。
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xìnggé kāilǎng, lèguān, yùdào máfan yě bù huì wǎng huàichù xiǎng.
examples.english: My older brother has a cheerful and optimistic personality; even when he encounters trouble, he won't think about the bad side.

examples.chinese: 妹妹知道自己考上了最好的研究所，激動地哭了起來。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei zhīdào zìjǐ kǎo shàng le zuì hǎo de yánjiūsuǒ, jīdòng de kū le qǐlái.
examples.english: When my younger sister learned that she had gotten into the best graduate school, she was so excited that she started crying.

examples.chinese: 他努力了三年，終於考上了最好的大學，他激動得流下了眼淚。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǔlì le sān nián, zhōngyú kǎoshàng le zuì hǎo de dàxué, tā jīdòng de liú xià le yǎnlèi.
examples.english: He worked hard for three years and finally got into the best university; he was so excited that he shed tears.

examples.chinese: 當掉進海裡的小孩被救上來時，大家都激動地歡呼了起來。
A:聽說王先生有很多女朋友？ B:真的嗎？我不信他是這種人。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō Wáng xiānsheng yǒu hěn duō nǚpéngyou? B: Zhēn de ma? Wǒ bú xìn tā shì zhè zhǒng rén.
examples.english: A: I heard Mr. Wang has many girlfriends? B: Really? I don't believe he is that kind of person.

examples.chinese: 他說的話不一定是真的，你別相信他。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà bù yīdìng shì zhēn de, nǐ bié xiāngxìn tā.
examples.english: What he says isn't necessarily true—don't believe him.

examples.chinese: 大學給我一封正式的信，通知我得到獎學金了。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué gěi wǒ yì fēng zhèngshì de xìn, tōngzhī wǒ dédào jiǎngxuéjīn le.
examples.english: The university gave me a formal letter notifying me that I have received a scholarship.

examples.chinese: 我相信有專業能力就比較容易找到好工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn yǒu zhuānyè nénglì jiù bǐjiào róngyì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò.
examples.english: I believe that if you have professional ability, it is relatively easy to find a good job.

examples.chinese: 我買了幾張當地的明信片，這些是這次旅行很好的紀念。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile jǐ zhāng dāngdì de míngxìnpiàn, zhèxiē shì zhè cì lǚxíng hěn hǎo de jìniàn.
examples.english: I bought several local postcards; these are a very good souvenir of this trip.

examples.chinese: 我寫信給父母，跟他們說我在台灣很安全，請他們放心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiě xìn gěi fùmǔ, gēn tāmen shuō wǒ zài Táiwān hěn ānquán, qǐng tāmen fàngxīn.
examples.english: I wrote a letter to my parents, telling them that I am very safe in Taiwan and asking them to rest assured.

examples.chinese: 他昨天去逛夜市的時候，信用卡被偷了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuótiān qù guàng yèshì de shíhou, xìnyòngkǎ bèi tōu le.
examples.english: When he went to the night market yesterday, his credit card was stolen.

examples.chinese: 我常常用中文給台灣朋友寫信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng yòng Zhōngwén gěi Táiwān péngyǒu xiě xìn.
examples.english: I often write letters to Taiwanese friends in Chinese.

examples.chinese: 我要到郵局去寄信，也要買一些信封。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào dào yóujú qù jì xìn, yě yào mǎi yīxiē xìnfēng.
examples.english: I want to go to the post office to mail a letter, and also buy some envelopes.

examples.chinese: A:我希望將來能當一名很棒的導演。 B:我相信只要你不斷地努力，就能夢想成真的！
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng yī míng hěn bàng de dǎoyǎn. B: Wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào nǐ bùduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de!
examples.english: A: I hope that in the future I can become a great director. B: I believe that as long as you keep working hard, your dreams will come true!

examples.chinese: 付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin: Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán. Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english: When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk. He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 聽說坐月子時不能洗頭髮，要不然對身體不好，你相信這樣的說法嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zuòyuèzi shí bùnéng xǐ tóufa, yàobùrán duì shēntǐ bù hǎo, nǐ xiāngxìn zhèyàng de shuōfǎ ma?
examples.english: I heard that during confinement you can't wash your hair, otherwise it's bad for your health. Do you believe this version?

examples.chinese: 我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察。A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, lǐmiàn yǒu hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, děi mǎshàng gàosu jǐngchá. A: Nǐ zěnme yīzhí késòu? Yào bùyào qù kàn yīshēng? B: Bù yàojǐn, wǒ chī guò yào le, xiūxi yīxià jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: I lost my wallet; inside were my passport and credit card. This matter is very important; I must tell the police immediately. A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's not important; I've taken medicine, and I'll be fine after a little rest.

examples.chinese: 沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi. Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.
examples.english: No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well. Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The travel itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as sightseeing, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 我奶奶不會用電腦，每次想跟朋友連絡，不是去郵局寄信就是打家裡的電話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bú huì yòng diànnǎo, měi cì xiǎng gēn péngyǒu liánluò, bú shì qù yóujú jì xìn jiù shì dǎ jiālǐ de diànhuà.
examples.english: My grandmother doesn't know how to use a computer. Every time she wants to contact her friends, she either goes to the post office to mail a letter or calls the home phone.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The tour itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as visiting, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 刷卡購物時，店員會先確認你的簽名是不是和信用卡上的相同。
examples.pinyin: Shuākǎ gòuwù shí, diànyuán huì xiān quèrèn nǐ de qiānmíng shì bùshì hé xìnyòngkǎ shàng de xiāngtóng.
examples.english: When paying by credit card, the clerk will first confirm whether your signature is the same as the one on the credit card.

examples.chinese: 張先生滑雪的技巧很好，這次比賽他有信心能夠得到前三名。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng huáxuě de jìqiǎo hěn hǎo, zhè cì bǐsài tā yǒu xìnxīn nénggòu dédào qián sān míng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's skiing skills are very good; for this competition, he has confidence that he can get into the top three.

examples.chinese: 小畢本來認為自己的書法寫得很好，但是上次比賽輸了以後，他就失去自信了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bì běnlái rènwéi zìjǐ de shūfǎ xiě de hěn hǎo, dànshì shàng cì bǐsài shū le yǐhòu, tā jiù shīqù zìxìn le.
examples.english: Xiǎo Bì originally thought his calligraphy was very good, but after losing the last competition, he lost his self-confidence.

examples.chinese: 老闆收到一封寫滿越南文的信，辦公室沒人看得懂，非找人翻譯不可。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shōudào yī fēng xiě mǎn Yuènánwén de xìn, bàngōngshì méi rén kàn de dǒng, fēi zhǎo rén fānyì bùkě.
examples.english: The boss received a letter written entirely in Vietnamese; no one in the office could understand it, so he absolutely must find someone to translate it.

examples.chinese: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ chúle jiàodǎo háizi zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, yě yīnggāi kěndìng tāmen de biǎoxiàn, ràng tāmen gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Besides teaching children the principles of how to conduct themselves and do things, parents should also affirm their performance so that they have more confidence.

examples.chinese: 我覺得馬小姐找不到工作的原因不是自己的條件不夠好，是他太缺乏自信了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Mǎ xiǎojiě zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò de yuányīn bùshì zìjǐ de tiáojiàn bù gòu hǎo, shì tā tài quēfá zìxìn le.
examples.english: I think the reason Miss Ma can't find a job is not that her own qualifications aren't good enough, but that she lacks self-confidence too much.

examples.chinese: 電影明星一向很重視自己的穿著，合適的穿著才能讓他們更有品味、更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng míngxīng yīxiàng hěn zhòngshì zìjǐ de chuānzhuó, héshì de chuānzhuó cái néng ràng tāmen gèng yǒu pǐnwèi, gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Movie stars have always attached great importance to their clothing; only suitable clothing can make them have more taste and more confidence.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī. Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of. The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese: 有人信上帝，有人不信。但在東西方的文化中，「上帝」的角色都是很重要的。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén xìn Shàngdì, yǒu rén bú xìn. Dàn zài dōng xīfāng de wénhuà zhōng, “Shàngdì” de juésè dōu shì hěn zhòngyào de.
examples.english: Some people believe in God, and some do not. But in both Eastern and Western cultures, the role of “God” is very important.

examples.chinese: 出國留學有不少好處，例如打開視野、增加自信、提高外文程度等等。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué yǒu bùshǎo hǎochù, lìrú dǎkāi shìyě, zēngjiā zìxìn, tígāo wàiwén chéngdù děngděng.
examples.english: Studying abroad has many benefits, for example, broadening one's horizons, increasing self-confidence, improving foreign language proficiency, and so on.

examples.chinese: 現代人往往以網路傳訊息，代替傳統寫信或打電話的方式。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén wǎngwǎng yǐ wǎnglù chuán xiāoxi, dàitì chuántǒng xiě xìn huò dǎ diànhuà de fāngshì.
examples.english: Modern people often use the internet to send messages, replacing the traditional ways of writing letters or making phone calls.

examples.chinese: 有人說，這個世界是上帝創造的，你相信嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒurén shuō, zhège shìjiè shì Shàngdì chuàngzào de, nǐ xiāngxìn ma?
examples.english: Some people say that this world was created by God; do you believe it?

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 有一些研究科學的人，對不科學、無法合理解釋的現象都不太相信。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē yánjiū kēxué de rén, duì bù kēxué, wúfǎ hélǐ jiěshì de xiànxiàng dōu bú tài xiāngxìn.
examples.english: Some people who study science do not really believe in unscientific phenomena that cannot be reasonably explained.

examples.chinese: 大信覺得這個公司的薪水跟福利都不好，於是決定換工作。
examples.pinyin: Dàxìn juéde zhège gōngsī de xīnshuǐ gēn fúlì dōu bù hǎo, yúshì juédìng huàn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Daxin felt that this company's salary and benefits were both bad, so he decided to change jobs.

examples.chinese: 收到別人的信時，應該回信告訴對方收到了，這是一種禮貌。
我已經退休了，不過還時常跟幾位要好的同事通信。
前天我收到大學的來信，才知道我被錄取了，真開心。
寄掛號信雖然貴了一點兒，可是比較可靠。
人人都有屬於自己的長處，要對自己更有信心。
答應別人的事就要做到，這才是有信用的人。
國外旅行時隨時攜帶護照、信用卡，可讓你玩得安心又順利。
刷卡買東西很方便，用讀卡機器刷一下信用卡就能付錢了。
信用卡的正面和背面都有一組號碼，在線上刷卡時用得到。
在表演以前準備得越多，上舞臺就越有自信。
假如失去了人民的信心與支持，國家也會變得不安定。
經過兩段不幸的感情生活，那位女士對愛情已失去了信心。
我們全家都是信基督教的，不論教會舉辦什麼活動，我們都一定去參加。
這位郵差的聲音很大，每次他來送信，整條街全都聽見了。
有朋友與家人的鼓勵，使他在面對任何困難時都十分自信。
中國古代的人們相信，當好人碰到危險或困難時，會有神仙到人間來幫助他們。
迷信的人老是相信一些不真實的迷信，例如：黑貓會帶來不好的運氣、送傘給情人就會分手什麼的。
情侶之間如果無法相信彼此，很容易就分手了。

items.wordHook: a 亻(person) puts their 言(speech) on paper and sends it → a 信(letter) to a friend.

examples.chinese: 便利商店的服務有賣票、收電話費和水電費等。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn de fúwù yǒu mài piào, shōu diànhuàfèi hé shuǐdiànfèi děng.
examples.english: The services at the convenience store include selling tickets, collecting telephone bills, and water and electricity bills, etc.

examples.chinese: 那位服務生不笑的時候，樣子看起來很兇，其實他對客人的態度很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúwùshēng bù xiào de shíhou, yàngzi kàn qǐlái hěn xiōng, qíshí tā duì kèrén de tàidù hěn hǎo.
examples.english: When that waiter doesn't smile, he looks very fierce, but actually his attitude toward customers is very good.

examples.chinese: 許多大學生參加愛心服務的社團，幫助老人打掃環境。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō dàxuéshēng cānjiā àixīn fúwù de shètuán, bāngzhù lǎorén dǎsǎo huánjìng.
examples.english: Many university students join volunteer service clubs to help the elderly clean up the environment.

examples.chinese: 愛心服務社社員去安養院陪老人過年，讓老人們感覺相當溫暖。
examples.pinyin: Àixīn fúwùshè shèyuán qù ānyǎngyuàn péi lǎorén guò nián, ràng lǎorénmen gǎnjué xiāngdāng wēnnuǎn.
examples.english: The members of the Love Service Club went to the nursing home to accompany the elderly through the New Year, making the elderly feel quite warm.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生對客人很親切，讓客人都吃得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng duì kèrén hěn qīnqiè, ràng kèrén dōu chī de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: The waiters at that restaurant are very kind to the customers, which makes the customers all eat happily.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我喜歡週末跟家人聚在一起吃飯、聊天。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"愛心服務社把社員的愛心聚在一起，到安養院去幫助老人。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zhōumò gēn jiārén jù zài yīqǐ chīfàn, liáotiān. Àixīn fúwùshè bǎ shèyuán de àixīn jù zài yīqǐ, dào ānyǎngyuàn qù bāngzhù lǎorén.
examples.english: I like to gather with my family on weekends to eat and chat. The Love Service Club gathers the members' love together and goes to the nursing home to help the elderly.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我參加了愛心服務社以後，想法比以前更成熟了。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"香蕉還沒成熟的時候是綠色的，等變成黃色就熟了。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cānjiā le àixīn fúwùshè yǐhòu, xiǎngfǎ bǐ yǐqián gèng chéngshú le. Xiāngjiāo hái méi chéngshú de shíhou shì lǜsè de, děng biàn chéng huángsè jiù shú le.
examples.english: After I joined the volunteer service club, my thinking has become more mature than before. When bananas are not yet ripe, they are green; when they turn yellow, they are ripe.

examples.chinese: 想要吸引顧客來購買價格高的商品，除了品質好，服務態度也很重要。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎngyào xīyǐn gùkè lái gòumǎi jiàgé gāo de shāngpǐn, chúle pǐnzhì hǎo, fúwù tàidù yě hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: If you want to attract customers to buy high-priced products, in addition to good quality, service attitude is also very important.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳不僅服務態度好，而且食物好吃又便宜，難怪大家都推薦我來嚐嚐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bùjǐn fúwù tàidù hǎo, érqiě shíwù hǎochī yòu piányi, nánguài dàjiā dōu tuījiàn wǒ lái chángchang.
examples.english: This restaurant not only has a good service attitude, but the food is also delicious and cheap; no wonder everyone recommended I come and try it.

examples.chinese: 因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播。這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, xiǎng yào zhīdào táifēng de xiāoxi, zhǐ néng tīng shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō. Zhège huódòng huìchǎng yǒu fúwù zhōngxīn, xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà, kěyǐ qǐng fúwù rényuán guǎngbō.
examples.english: Because the power is out, if you want to know news about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast. There is a service center at this event venue; if you want to find someone, you can ask the service staff to make an announcement.

examples.chinese: A: 現在的科技提供非常好用的網路服務，而且很多都是免費的。 B: 好用倒是好用，可是萬一沒有網路，就什麼都做不了了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài de kējì tígōng fēicháng hǎoyòng de wǎnglù fúwù, érqiě hěnduō dōu shì miǎnfèi de. B: Hǎoyòng dàoshì hǎoyòng, kěshì wànyī méiyǒu wǎnglù, jiù shénme dōu zuò bù liǎo le.
examples.english: A: Today's technology provides very easy-to-use internet services, and many are free. B: Sure, it's easy to use, but if there's no internet, then you can't do anything.

examples.chinese: 他參加了服務社團的活動後，生活比過去更豐富、更有意義。
examples.pinyin: Tā cānjiā le fúwù shètuán de huódòng hòu, shēnghuó bǐ guòqù gèng fēngfù, gèng yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: After he participated in the service club's activities, his life has become richer and more meaningful than in the past.

examples.chinese: 這個國家公園的服務中心提供遊客簡介，介紹公園的特色和有名的景點。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā gōngyuán de fúwù zhōngxīn tígōng yóukè jiǎnjiè, jièshào gōngyuán de tèsè hé yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: This national park's service center provides visitors with a brief introduction, introducing the park's features and famous scenic spots.

examples.chinese: 這個保養品很適合皮膚乾的人，所以秋冬兩個季節銷售得非常好。因為店員的服務態度很好，所以這個專櫃的銷售成績是最好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bǎoyǎngpǐn hěn shìhé pífū gān de rén, suǒyǐ qiū dōng liǎng ge jìjié xiāoshòu de fēicháng hǎo. Yīnwèi diànyuán de fúwù tàidù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhège zhuān guì de xiāoshòu chéngjì shì zuì hǎo de.
examples.english: This skincare product is very suitable for people with dry skin, so its sales in the autumn and winter seasons are very good. Because the staff's service attitude is very good, this counter's sales performance is the best.

examples.chinese: 這家電腦公司本來只服務亞洲地區的民眾，現在服務範圍已經擴大到歐洲了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diànnǎo gōngsī běnlái zhǐ fúwù Yàzhōu dìqū de mínzhòng, xiànzài fúwù fànwéi yǐjīng kuòdà dào Ōuzhōu le.
examples.english: This computer company originally only served people in the Asian region, but now its service range has already expanded to Europe.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 易先生從職場退休後，就加入了醫院的服務社團，繼續為社會貢獻一份力量。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng cóng zhíchǎng tuìxiū hòu, jiù jiārù le yīyuàn de fúwù shètuán, jìxù wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng.
examples.english: After Mr. Yi retired from the workplace, he joined the hospital's service club and continued to contribute his part to society.

examples.chinese: 經過服務人員詳細地說明，使得客人對公司的產品更了解了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò fúwù rényuán xiángxì de shuōmíng, shǐde kèrén duì gōngsī de chǎnpǐn gèng liǎojiě le.
examples.english: After the service staff's detailed explanation, it made the customers understand the company's products better.

examples.chinese: 要是你在百貨公司掉了東西，可以去服務中心的櫃臺問問。
那家餐廳的服務生很貼心，只要客人一上門，立刻提供面紙給客人擦手。
我想加入社會服務組織，幫助別人的同時也讓自己成長。
臺灣的超商有店到店的送貨服務，不但速度快，運費也不貴。
那家餐廳的服務生很厲害，一隻手能端好幾個盤子。
你帶著邀請卡給門口的服務人員檢查，才能入場參加活動。
如果想入會員並享受我們健身房所提供的服務，請您到櫃臺辦理。
在這家餐廳，沒有人替你服務，點菜、拿碗筷等一切都得自助。
這所學校規定學生每兩週至少參加一次服務學習活動。
班機起飛前，服務人員都會為旅客說明應注意的安全規定。
行動不方便的乘客乘車時，車站有服務員為他們服務。
這家餐廳的帳單已經加了服務費了，你不必再給小費。
我曾經在賣精油的商店服務過一段時間。
個人在使用各式各樣的網路服務時，也應該注意隱私問題。
個性親切、大方，通常是從事服務業的最佳人才。
他對志工服務一向有興趣，哪怕做得又忙又累，他也願意。
對顧客來說，品牌代表了對公司服務的印象以及商品的品質。

items.wordHook: Combining 服(wear) and 務(affairs): 服務 means service.

examples.chinese: 我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察。A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, lǐmiàn yǒu hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, děi mǎshàng gàosu jǐngchá. A: Nǐ zěnme yīzhí késòu? Yào bùyào qù kàn yīshēng? B: Bù yàojǐn, wǒ chī guò yào le, xiūxi yīxià jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: I lost my wallet; inside were my passport and credit card. This matter is very important; I must tell the police immediately. A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's not important; I've taken medicine, and I'll be fine after a little rest.

items.wordHook: Combining 要(essential) and 緊(tight): 要緊 means important.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 為了避免兒童發生意外，家長在樓梯邊裝了安全網。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn értóng fāshēng yìwài, jiāzhǎng zài lóutī biān zhuāng le ānquán wǎng.
examples.english: To avoid accidents involving children, the parents installed a safety net beside the stairs.

examples.chinese: 下週五有上百位家長會到我們學校，一同參加全校運動會。

items.wordHook: Combining 家(family) and 長(grow): 家長 means parent.

examples.chinese: 在學習中文的期間，小林下課後除了複習功課，也和同學參加了不少社團活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuéxí Zhōngwén de qījiān, Xiǎo Lín xiàkè hòu chúle fùxí gōngkè, yě hé tóngxué cānjiā le bùshǎo shètuán huódòng.
examples.english: During the period of studying Chinese, after class Xiao Lin not only reviewed his lessons but also participated in quite a few club activities with classmates.

examples.chinese: 打仗期間，許多軍人為國家犧牲了寶貴的生命，也給家人留下了痛苦的記憶。
examples.pinyin: Dǎzhàng qījiān, xǔduō jūnrén wèi guójiā xīshēngle bǎoguì de shēngmìng, yě gěi jiārén liúxiàle tòngkǔ de jìyì.
examples.english: During the war, many soldiers sacrificed their precious lives for the country, and also left painful memories for their families.

examples.chinese: 外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助。那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。
examples.pinyin: 1. Wàiguórén zài Táiwān shēnghuó qījiān, rúguǒ yùdào rènhé wèntí, dōu kěyǐ dǎ 0800-024111, qǐngqiú xiézhù. 2. Nàge huàirén shā le rén, tā zhīdào zìjǐ cuò le, dào jiàotáng qù qǐngqiú Shàngdì yuánliàng.
examples.english: 1. During their time living in Taiwan, if foreigners encounter any problems, they can call 0800-024111 to request assistance. 2. That bad person killed someone; he knew he was wrong and went to church to beg God for forgiveness.

examples.chinese: 不少人利用新年期間到國外旅行，國內過年的氣氛就越來越淡了。
老師把安養院社團的社員分成兩個小組，第一組陪老人唱歌， 第二組陪老人玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ ānyǎngyuàn shètuán de shèyuán fēnchéng liǎng ge xiǎozǔ, dì-yī zǔ péi lǎorén chànggē, dì-èr zǔ péi lǎorén wán yóuxì.
examples.english: The teacher divided the members of the nursing home club into two groups: the first group sang songs with the elderly, and the second group played games with the elderly.

examples.chinese: 我父親是個警察，只要他負責的小組有重要任務時，就得出差一兩個星期。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn shì ge jǐngchá, zhǐyào tā fùzé de xiǎozǔ yǒu zhòngyào rènwu shí, jiù děi chūchāi yī liǎng ge xīngqī.
examples.english: My father is a police officer; whenever the team he is responsible for has an important task, he has to go on a business trip for one or two weeks.

examples.chinese: 我想加入社會服務組織，幫助別人的同時也讓自己成長。
信用卡的正面和背面都有一組號碼，在線上刷卡時用得到。
同事搬新家，我們送他一組茶具，恭喜他吧。
老師不滿意我們這一組的報告，要我們重做一次。
在機構、組織擔任的職位越高，代表個人所負擔的責任越重。
我跟幾個愛好歷史的朋友一起組了社團，專門研究古文物。
那位服裝設計師相當喜愛十八世紀時的歐洲傳統風格。
許多世紀以來，受壓迫的民族都渴望擁有平等的待遇。
以前人們常用磁帶來存電腦的重要資料。
這家造船公司製造的船因成本高，價錢稍微貴了一點兒。
使用高度技術製造出來的工業生產機器，操作起來往往更有效率。
職業棒球隊在比賽時，會請專業啦啦隊來製造熱鬧氣氛。
這家工廠奪下了著名品牌產品的製造機會。
她的專業是人工智慧，這個領域的問題可以請教她。
他對發展新科技向來保守，不願接受人工智慧產品。
算起來我們已經好久沒吃餃子了，買點兒麵粉、青菜和肉，回家包餃子吧。
她把蛋白拌進麵粉裡，加點兒花生烤一烤，又香又好吃。
